title: [finding] `proxyRearmPlan`'s reason names `HTTPS_PROXY` read uppercase-first, while node 22's `--use-env-proxy` honours the lowercase `https_proxy` first — when the pair disagrees the route line names a proxy the child never uses
body:
## What is measured

`proxyRearmPlan` (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, the shared re-exec plan every routed instrument imports) reads the proxy as `env.HTTPS_PROXY || env.https_proxy` (:19569) and words its reason with that value: 「HTTPS_PROXY is set (<value>) and node's fetch does not read it」. Node 22's `--use-env-proxy` honours the **lowercase** `https_proxy` first. When the two variables disagree, the route line names a proxy the child never uses.

Measured on `scripts/check-closing-target-claim.mjs` at `c1e174eba1` (PR #18998's head, which carries the mapper shape), node v22.22.2, in an agent container where both variables are normally set to the same value:

| environment | reason line printed | what the child reached |
|---|---|---|
| `HTTPS_PROXY` = live proxy, `https_proxy` = `http://127.0.0.1:1` | 「HTTPS_PROXY is set (http://127.0.0.1:37101) …」 | `ECONNREFUSED` — the dead lowercase one; exit 3 |
| `HTTPS_PROXY` = `http://127.0.0.1:1`, `https_proxy` = live proxy | 「HTTPS_PROXY is set (http://127.0.0.1:1) …」 | routed; a real per-target verdict at exit 0 |

The DECISION is unaffected (either variable set ⇒ re-arm, which is right); only the reason text and the value it quotes are wrong in the disagreeing case, so a reader diagnosing an `ECONNREFUSED` or a 401 after the re-exec is pointed at the wrong variable.

## Why it is small, and still a card

Every container this seat has read sets both variables to one value, so the disagreeing case is constructed, not encountered — p3 in this seat's reading (the grading seat's call). It is filed because the reason line is the one thing a reader acts on, and the refusal text in `boardNotReadRefusal` / the siblings' remedies now quote it as the remedy.

Suggested shape, ⛔ not prescribed: read the pair in node's own order (`env.https_proxy || env.HTTPS_PROXY`) and name the variable that was actually read in the reason.

## Dedup

Read the shift's corpus (open + closed to #18912, both ends) and the cards opened since for `https_proxy`, `EnvHttpProxyAgent`, `proxyRoute`: #13544 (closed — the `--probe` PREREQUISITE NOT MET in a container, the origin of the re-exec), #15234 (closed — two gates sharing one `NODE_OPTIONS`), #18939 / PR #18980 (the guard cross-suppression), #18947 / PR #18998 (the file this was measured on). None names the uppercase-first read or the reason text. Dedup words: `proxyRearmPlan`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, `https_proxy`, `uppercase-first`, `reason line`.
